scope: USB iOS defaults to ReplayKit video in every new mirror window
behavior: First PNG establishes geometry; video starts automatically through the shared device queue
Manual screenshot selection persists within the same window across USB and explicit reconnect
Video startup failure preserves PNG only after successful owned capture cleanup and fresh screenshot
Startup toolbar disables duplicate actions and displays starting status

physical.method: Fresh production app session started via CLI, without an attached browser debugger during window creation; no video toggle invoked

validation.electronUI: passed: English/Chinese, light/dark, startup controls disabled, PNG/H264 and mode toggles; simulated device IPC

limits: Initial windows created while a browser debugger was attached lacked VideoDecoder and fell back to PNG; restarting and creating the window without that debugger attachment produced working video. The debugger-specific cause is not established.
This run does not repeat the physical USB unplug/replug matrix; mode retention is covered by automated tests.
